input.reason: "Easier to read" doesn't say what should change, so I can't write a test for it yet. Right now `todo list` prints lines like "[ ] buy milk" with no id or due date. That matters because `complete` needs the id. There are several reasonable fixes and they would change the existing format tests differently, so I need the exact target before I plan the work.
input.question:
Which output should become easier to read, and what should it look like? Here's my suggestion for `todo list`. Each line would show the id, the status, the title and the due date if there is one, with columns lined up, like this:
  #1 [ ] buy milk   (due 2026-11-01)
  #2 [x] walk dog
  #3 [ ] pay rent   (due 2026-10-31)
Should I do that? A few other choices to make:
(a) Should the list be sorted, for example open todos first, then by due date, instead of in insertion order?
(b) Should it end with a summary line such as "2 open, 1 done"?
(c) Should the "Added #1", "Completed #2" and error messages change too, for example "Added #1: buy milk"?
(d) Should "No todos." stay as it is?
If your idea of "easier to read" is something else, please give an example of the exact output you want.
